state.title: Bump the actions group with 2 updates
state.description:
Bumps the actions group with 2 updates: [actions/setup-python](https://github.com/actions/setup-python) and [zizmorcore/zizmor-action](https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action). Updates `actions/setup-python` from 6.3.0 to 7.0.0
Release notes

Sourced from actions/setup-python's releases.

v7.0.0

What's Changed

Enhancements

  • Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies by @​priyagupta108 in actions/setup-python#1330
  • Pin SHA commits and update docs with latest versions by @​HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-python#1338
  • Remove the pip-install input by @​gowridurgad in actions/setup-python#1336

Bug Fix

  • Fix to Classify stderr warning messages as warnings instead of errors in annotations by @​lmvysakh in actions/setup-python#1335
  • Validate and retry manifest fetch to prevent silent failures by @​priyagupta108 in actions/setup-python#1332

Dependency Upgrade

  • Bump certifi from 2020.6.20 to 2024.7.4 in /tests/data by @​dependabot in actions/setup-python#1328
  • Remove EOL Python versions and Bumps numpy text fixture by @​priya-kinthali in actions/setup-python#1333
  • Upgrade @​actions/cache to 6.2.0 by @​philip-gai in actions/setup-python#1337

New Contributors

  • @​lmvysakh made their first contribution in actions/setup-python#1335
  • @​philip-gai made their first contribution in actions/setup-python#1337

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/setup-python/compare/v6...v7.0.0

Commits
  • 5fda3b9 Pin SHA commits and update docs with latest versions (#1338)
  • 4ab7e95 Merge pull request #1337 from actions/philip-gai/bump-actions-cache-6-2-0
  • 0f3a009 Remove the pip-install input (#1336)
  • f8cf429 Migrate to ESM and upgrade dependencies (#1330)
  • 54baeea Validate and retry manifest fetch to prevent silent failures (#1332)
  • c709277 Annotation code fix (#1335)
  • 6849080 remove EOL Python versions and Bumps numpy text fixture (#1333)
  • 0903b46 Bump certifi from 2020.6.20 to 2024.7.4 in /tests/data (#1328)
  • See full diff in compare view

v0.6.0

zizmor 1.27.0 is now the default version used by the action.

What's Changed

  • Fold Docker image pull output into a collapsed Actions log group by @​woodruffw with @​Copilot in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#132
  • Readme: document missing inputs by @​staabm in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#130
  • ci: block version sync workflow on forks by @​shaanmajid in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#129
  • Sync zizmor versions by @​github-actions[bot] in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#137
  • Add collect input by @​woodruffw in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#139

New Contributors

  • @​woodruffw with @​Copilot made their first contribution in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#132
  • @​staabm made their first contribution in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#130
  • @​shaanmajid made their first contribution in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#129

state.scope: PR metadata and complete diff only; no full repository checkout, linked issue bodies, inline review threads, CI logs or locally executed upstream tests.

value.instructions: Choose the value category under the fixed criteria. Small changes can be meaningful. Dependency/release maintenance is valuable but distinct from a substantive fix. Do not use approval or popularity as evidence.

criteria.substantive: A concrete functional, security, documentation correctness or test-quality benefit beyond routine upkeep is supported by the description and diff. A dependency bump fixing a specific reported failure qualifies. This assesses purpose, not proof of runtime correctness.
criteria.routine_maintenance: Legitimate upkeep such as routine dependency pins or release metadata, without a specific project failure fixed by the diff. Not meaningless; upstream changelog features alone do not turn a routine pin bump into a project feature.
criteria.no_clear_value: The supplied evidence shows the change to be redundant, ineffective or purely churn, with no identifiable project benefit.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: The supplied material is missing or contradictory enough that even intended project value cannot be assessed.
